description: Communes de Seine-Maritime disposant d'un PAC Littoral - Normandie is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ws.carmen.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Les « Porter à connaissance » (PAC) littoraux concernent les secteurs à fort risque de submersion marine, non couverts par un PPRL (Plan de Prévention des Risques Littoraux) ou un TRI (Territoire à Risque important d’Inondation). Coverage: FR. Its keywords include Données ouvertes, Sols, Sites protégés, submersion, Géologie. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
